notes.text: This release is Direct Metal Mastered and features the DMM logo on the bottom left hand corner of the rear cover, along with the text "DMM is a trademark of TELDEC". A similar release,

, does not feature the logo or text but is still Direct Metal Mastered. 

Bass, Bass Synth and drums tracks recorded at Compass Point Studios, Nassau, Bahamas.
Guitars, Vocals, and Guitar Synth recorded at Wisseloord Studios, Hilversum, Holland.
Mixed at Electric Ladyland.
Mastered at Sterling Sound, New York.

Playing time 51:18 minutes.

Semi-glossy cover.
Inner sleeve with lyrics/credits and picture. This inner sleeve is of card, top opening with a die cut thumb section.

Some copies included an 8" by 8" double sided colour insert advertising merchandise and previous albums. This has a London address and a code "EJ 2402001 (I)".
